value.title: Running Scared
value.synopsis: Ikki's middle school gym teacher makes him and the Screws do A LOT of running, but when Ikki and Erika find out the gym teachers big secret, they decide to investigate.

value.title: The Legendary Medafighter
value.synopsis: Erika finds out about a ""legendary medafighter"" that supposedly goes to a snobby rich kids private school, so she and Ikki sneak in and go on a search to find him.

value.title: The Old Man and the Sea Monster
value.synopsis: The 'Old Man' helps Ikki and Metabee fight on water to to beat the bad bully-meanies.

value.title: The Gimme Ghost
value.synopsis: Ikki and Erika find out that there are ghosts stealing medals in a forest so they decide to check it out. There they find Karen and Koji who are also looking for the 'Gimmie Ghost' as he is called.

value.title: Cyandog Bites Back
value.synopsis: Spyke and Cyandog never seem to win a Ro-Battle so Samantha kicks him them out of the Screws gang. Spyke and Cyandog ask Metabee and Ikki for training help and they find out that Cyandog is terrible at battle because he has the wrong type of medal.

value.title: For Better for Worse (1)
value.synopsis: It is time for the 10th Annual Medabot Citywide Ro-Battle. Ikki and Metabee want to enter but of course they can't get along and Metabee refuses to listen to Ikki in the Ro-Battles. They both manage to get to the finals anyway but the final test is Koji and Sumilidon. Can Ikki and Metabee get a grip and defeat Koji and Sumilidon. Find out in Part 2.

value.title: For Better for Worse (2)
value.synopsis: Metabee and Ikki are still furious at each other, so Metabee decides not to listen to Ikki. Even though Ikki tries to help Metabee, Metabee tunes him out and loses the Ro-Battle. After the defeat, Metabee's medal pops out of the robot leaving it to be stollen by the Rubber Robo Gang. They manipulate Metabee to join the Rubber Robo Gang. Is it over for Ikki and Metabee?

value.title: Mystery Medabot
value.synopsis: A mysterious Medabot has come to town. This Medabot goes by the name Rokusho. Ikki and his pals see him saving a puppy and they realise that he is faster than any Metabot they ever seen. Metabee finds out that Rokusho is a loner Medabot with his past shrouded in mystery.

value.title: Phantom Renegade: Unmasked
value.synopsis: Ikki is accused to be the Phantom Renagade by a reporter, so the reporter follows him everywhere and even starts to mimic the Phantom in the hopes that Ikki will reveal his secret. But then the real Phantom comes out into the open seeking revenge.

value.title: Ban All Medabots
value.synopsis: Angry moms that don't like Medabots are stealing kids' Medabots and pack them away. Ikki and Metabee talk some sense to the mean mothers and they get a grip and everyone lives happily ever after. For now, anyway.

value.title: Meet Your Meda-Maker
value.synopsis: The Rubber Robo Gang comes up with a plan to use Ikki and Metabee to steal a super rare medal from Dr. Aki him self, who is the creator of all Medabots and also Karin's uncle.

value.title: The Spy Who Robattled Me
value.synopsis: The Rubber Robo Gang tries to steal a rare medal from the Medabot Corporation. Inside, the Rubber Robo Gang steals Belzega, a Medabot that has one-hit-beats-him attack. Dr. Aki, realizing that the Rubber Robo Gang wants all the rare medals of the world, appoints the Phantom Renegade to protect them.

value.title: I Dream of Hushi
value.synopsis: Rokusho meets Ainsley, a woman that lost her husband in a war, and they start to become friends.

value.title: Metabee Vs Rokusho
value.synopsis: Rokusho finds out that Dr. Aki was the one that set fire to Dr. Hushi's house and Rokusho gets very angry. Metabee tries to protect Dr. Aki and has to Ro-Battle Rokusho. When Metabee is about to win, Rokusho uses the 'Medaforce' to pummel Metabee into oblivion.

value.title: Use the Medaforce
value.synopsis: Dr. Meta-Evil's super strong bot, the Robo-Emperor, starts wreaking havoc and Rokusho gets kidnapped by the Rubber Robo Gang and is taken to a ship where they hope to get a rare medal. Ikki finds more info on rare medals and discovers that Dr. Hushi was the first to find out that the Medaforce comes from a Medabot's rare medal.

value.title: Fifteen Minutes of Shame
value.synopsis: The preliminary rankings for top Medafighters off Japan is out. Ikki is #3, Koji is #2, and Space Medafighter X is #1. Ikki starts showing off for the cameras and Samantha (Leader of the Screws) claims that she taught Ikki all he knows.

value.title: Enter Rintaro
value.synopsis: Ikki and Erika go exploring when they find Spyke and Krosserdog attacked. They claim that a big Medabot attacked them. Afterwards, Samantha and other Medafighters blame Ikki for attacking their Medabots. They come to a conclusion that Metabee has been cloned. Meanwhile, Koji is knitting a sock, because nobody has challenged him to a Ro-Battle.

value.title: The Ace from Outer Space
value.synopsis: As the story returns to where it left off last episode, we see the mysterious Medabot reveal itself. It is a KBT type, Arcbeetle, and it belongs to the number 1 Medafighter in Japan, Space Medafighter X. Space Medafighter X challenges Shrimpy Lipowitz and wins easily, winning back Ikki's medal. As he returns the medal, he lectures Ikki that he should never fight for medals, only medaparts.

value.title: Me and My Shadow Sword
value.synopsis: After seeing Ikki and Metabee use the Medaforce, Koji decides to train harder than ever to be prepared in case he ever has to face it. Space Medafighter X shows up to help him learn a special technique, the "Shadow Sword", which will help him to do this.

value.title: Dude, Where's My Ma?
value.synopsis: Ikki and Metabee have to decide what to do. Do they want to make the rankings for the Medabots Ro-Battle Championships or does he want to save his mom?

value.title: X-treme Measures
value.synopsis: It's the day of the final standings for the World Robattle Tournaments and Ikki Tenryo is still in fourth place. With only 20 minutes until the closing of the rankings, Metabee is exhausted and the only new Medafighter nearby is Space Medafighter X.

value.title: The Road to Ruins
value.synopsis: The Rubbe Robo Gang swoops down and bot-naps Metabee. Because he is exhausted, he cannot fight back. They take Metabee to their secret hideout by helicopter.

value.title: Beetle Mania
value.synopsis: Dr. Meta-Evil uses Metabee's medal to control every Medabot in the world! Brass starts to attack Erika and Karin and Kantaroth starts attacking Rintaro and his group. Dr. Meta Evil was once Dr. Hushi's assistant. Dr. Hushi found out the power of the rare medals and he wanted to destroy all his research and findings, but Dr. Meta-Evil stole the information to use it for evil.

value.title: The Mother of All Robattles
value.synopsis: Dr. Meta-Evil looks to be finished. But is he? A strange cat puts a rare medal in to a huge Medabot and it takes Metabee, Rokusho, and ArcBeetle to fight him. Even when all 3 of them use the Medaforce, it doesn't seem to stop Giganko. Giganko goes into town destroying everything in sight. Not even the Police can stop this Medabot. Is all hope lost?
